title: Distilling Vision-Language Models for On-Device Fire Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2609.05782v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) offer a promising alternative to conventional fire detection systems by reasoning about the semantic context of a scene and thus reducing false alarms, yet their large model size makes deployment on embedded fire sensors impractical. In this paper, we study how domain-specialized VLMs can be compressed for fully on-device deployment without losing the safety-critical behavior required for fire detection. We develop a teacher-student knowledge distillation framework in which large VLMs fine-tuned for fire understanding can be distilled into lightweight students. Experiments across multiple VLM families and model scales show that compact students preserve most of their teachers' fire-understanding capability. We further deploy the distilled models on our commercial Detectium fire detection sensor and jointly evaluate reasoning accuracy, latency, and memory usage. translated_title: 面向端侧火灾理解的视觉语言模型蒸馏
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLM）通过推理场景的语义上下文来减少误报，为传统火灾探测系统提供了一种有前景的替代方案，但其庞大的模型规模使其难以部署在嵌入式火灾传感器上。本文研究了如何压缩领域专用的视觉语言模型，以实现完全端侧部署，同时不损失火灾探测所需的安全关键行为。我们开发了一个师生知识蒸馏框架，将针对火灾理解微调的大型视觉语言模型蒸馏为轻量级学生模型。在多个VLM系列和不同模型规模上的实验表明，紧凑的学生模型保留了其教师模型大部分的火灾理解能力。我们进一步将蒸馏后的模型部署在商用Detectium火灾探测传感器上，并联合评估了推理准确性、延迟和内存占用。结果表明，压缩与部署……
tldr: 本文提出一种师生知识蒸馏框架，将针对火灾理解微调的大型视觉语言模型压缩为轻量级学生模型，并成功部署于商用Detectium火灾探测传感器上，在保留火灾理解能力的同时实现完全端侧部署。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a teacher-student knowledge distillation framework that compresses large vision-language models fine-tuned for fire understanding into lightweight student models, successfully deployed on commercial Detectium fire detection sensors for fully on-device deployment while preserving fire-understanding capability.
